meta.description: Tests matching transceiver media to fiber links.

question.text: Which TWO factors should be checked when selecting a transceiver for a fiber link? Select two.
options: Whether the transceiver matches the fiber type and supported wavelength
Whether the transceiver supports the required data rate and connector/interface
The color of the switch chassis
The subnet mask assigned to the remote host
correctAnswers: Whether the transceiver matches the fiber type and supported wavelength
Whether the transceiver supports the required data rate and connector/interface
